settings.text: Journal: BMJ (British Medical Journal) 1999

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A systematic review by Wyatt et al. eval
settings.text: A systematic review by Wyatt et al. evaluated the efficacy of Vitamin B6 in treating premenstrual syndrome (PMS) symptoms. The review analyzed 25 clinical trials, involving various doses of Vitamin B6.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Key Findings:
settings.text: Key Findings:

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Vitamin B6 supplementation significantly
settings.text: Vitamin B6 supplementation significantly alleviates common PMS symptoms, including mood swings, irritability, and anxiety.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · B6 plays a crucial role in neurotransmit
settings.text: B6 plays a crucial role in neurotransmitter synthesis, particularly serotonin, which is essential for mood regulation and hormone balance.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Helps stabilize mood and improve emotion
settings.text: Helps stabilize mood and improve emotional well-being during the menstrual cycle.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · *Source: Wyatt KM, Dimmock PW, Jones PW,
settings.text: *Source: Wyatt KM, Dimmock PW, Jones PW, Shaughn O'Brien PM. Efficacy of vitamin B-6 in the treatment of premenstrual syndrome: systematic review. BMJ. 1999;318(7195):1375-1381.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A randomized, double-blind, placebo-cont
settings.text: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study involving 170 women aged 18-45 was conducted over 3 menstrual cycles to determine the effect of Vitex agnus-castus (Chasteberry) on premenstrual syndrome (PMS) symptoms.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Key Findings:
settings.text: Key Findings:

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Chasteberry significantly alleviates com
settings.text: Chasteberry significantly alleviates common PMS symptoms such as irritability, mood swings, anger, headache, and breast fullness.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Chasteberry aids in the regulation of ho
settings.text: Chasteberry aids in the regulation of hormones, particularly prolactin, which is beneficial for overall hormonal balance.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · By stabilizing hormone levels, Chasteber
settings.text: By stabilizing hormone levels, Chasteberry helps improve mood and reduce emotional distress associated with PMS.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · *Source: Schellenberg R. Treatment for t
settings.text: *Source: Schellenberg R. Treatment for the premenstrual syndrome with agnus castus fruit extract: prospective, randomised, placebo-controlled study. BMJ. 2001;322(7279):134-137.

settings.text: This study investigated the effect of Melissa officinalis (lemon balm) on the severity of PMS symptoms in high school students. A double-blind, placebo-controlled trial involving 100 participants was performed.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Journal: J Am Pharm Assoc (Wash) 2000
settings.text: Journal: J Am Pharm Assoc (Wash) 2000

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Dong Quai, or Angelica sinensis, has bee
settings.text: Dong Quai, or Angelica sinensis, has been utilized in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Known as "female ginseng," it is often used to address menstrual and menopausal symptoms. This study reviewed the efficacy and safety of specific herbal medications that have been used traditionally to treat common conditions in women.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Key Findings:
settings.text: Key Findings:

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Based on the available evidence Dong qua
settings.text: Based on the available evidence Dong quai may have some efficacy for PMS when used in traditional Chinese multiple-herb formulas.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Source: Hardy ML. Herbs of special inter
settings.text: Source: Hardy ML. Herbs of special interest to women. J Am Pharm Assoc (Wash). 2000 Mar-Apr;40(2):234-42; quiz 327-9.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · *In addition to the above, animal studie
settings.text: *In addition to the above, animal studies have shown that compounds in Dong Quai promote healthy blood circulation and provide both stimulating and relaxing effects on the uterus, which may support normal menstrual flow and pain relief. Clinical trials research is limited.
